title: An agent stopped at its deadline leaves no process of its own running
gap: attest.loop.call_agent runs the agent with subprocess.run(shell=True, timeout=...). On timeout only the shell it started is killed; the agent command under that shell, and any process it started, keep running past the deadline (observed on Linux with /bin/sh). The Kane runner stops its whole process group at the deadline (KR-ISO-06); the agent call has no equivalent yet.
